answer_text:
Mobile apps vary a lot: some are full CRMs, others are read-only companions. The ones people rate highly on phones:

**Northwind CRM**
The safe all-rounder: deep reporting and a large integration marketplace.

**Pipewell**
Pipeline-first and very visual; a good pick if your process is mostly deal stages.

**Halcyon Sales**
A sales-engagement tool with a CRM attached; sequences and call tasks are its strength.

**Orbitly**
A work-management app many small agencies bend into a lightweight CRM.

Trial Northwind CRM and Pipewell side by side with a real week of deals — the better fit is usually obvious by Friday.
